test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. I sits to the immediate left of D. J is the immediate neighbour of both B and K. K sits third to the left of D. L is not an immediate neighbour of K. Who sits second to the right of C?
solution:
Seven people, B, C, D, I, J, K and L, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. I sits to the immediate left of D.

2. J is the immediate neighbour of both B and K.

3. K sits third to the left of D.

4. L is not an immediate neighbour of K. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64b4c8722f0e6e38bd43579d2cd9423d60535e444f9174466a2c252afae416a4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3737844249b0960140e6646a49373dc3579683c935787ce73956a192e79b1dd8.png] 

D sits second to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
